subject.title: Feature Request: Add channel creation to message tool

question: Should OpenClaw expose workspace/server channel creation through the message tool and CLI, and if so what default-off provider gates, scopes, and requester-authorization boundary should Slack and Discord use?
rationale: Channel creation lets agents mutate Slack workspaces and Discord servers, and current code lacks an accepted Slack admin gate or cross-provider authority model; automation should not choose that boundary on its own.

options.title: Approve default-off provider gates
options.body: Define explicit provider-owned channel admin gates and scopes, implement Slack channel creation behind them, and land or replace the Discord CLI subset after security acceptance.

options.title: Narrow to Discord CLI first
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/65065 as the only near-term work and leave Slack admin channel creation as a separate later decision.

options.title: Decline native channel creation
options.body: Keep workspace/server provisioning in provider-native admin tools or external scripts unless a stronger product need appears.

recommendation.title: Approve default-off provider gates
recommendation.body: Define explicit provider-owned channel admin gates and scopes, implement Slack channel creation behind them, and land or replace the Discord CLI subset after security acceptance.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter authored the detailed prior review and has recent blame on the central CLI, Slack discovery, and Discord action files.
